semiconductor_relevance: High — AST Engineering specializes in temperature sensing solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AST Engineering, established in 2004, provides advanced temperature sensing solutions for the semiconductor industry, including thermocouples and temperature mapping software. Their products are designed to enhance process control in various semiconductor fabrication processes such as diffusion, CVD, and etching.
capabilities: Temperature sensors with a measurement range of -200 ℃ to 1200 ℃
24 Bit ADC with high-speed sampling capabilities
Thermocouples for various applications including LED and semiconductor substrates
